profile.summary: Dhatre Udyog Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products in India. The company offers TMT bars, rounds, squares, angles; and trading of billets, blooms, ingots, iron ores, etc. The company was formerly known as Narayani Steels Limited and changed its name to Dhatre Udyog Limited in May 2023. Dhatre Udyog Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Kolkata, India.
